whyItaly.title: Why Italy matters.
whyItaly.p1: We work directly with an Italian maker. We want craftsmanship you can feel in the stitching, the weight of the hardware, and how the bag holds its shape over time — not just a “Made in Italy” label on someone else’s story.
whyItaly.p2: We will share materials and construction with concrete facts once they are finalized with the manufacturer. Until then, we promise only what we can stand behind.
whyItaly.li2: Approach: a small, carefully chosen selection
whyItaly.li3: Promise: clear facts instead of loud superlatives

italy.title: Made in Italy
italy.body: Origin is part of the promise — described with facts, not slogans.

price.title: Prices without masks
price.body: Prices are shown in euro. What you see here is the price we are talking about.

policies.title: Honest policies
policies.body: Shipping, returns, and payment — published before sales. No fake reviews and no artificial scarcity.

origin.a: In Italy, with our manufacturing partner. Once we finalize the public details about the atelier and region, we will publish them here — clearly and without embellishment.

materials.a: For each model we will describe the material, lining, and hardware once we have final confirmation. We prefer to wait for the facts rather than promise “premium leather” on guesswork.

delivery.a: Delivery times for Bulgaria will be announced before the first orders. Right now we are collecting interest for early access — with no payment.

deliveryCost.a: We will state it clearly at checkout, together with the terms. We work with logistics for Bulgaria and will not hide fees in fine print.

returns.a: Yes — before sales begin we will publish a full returns policy aligned with your consumer rights. It will be readable, not buried in terms and conditions.

damage.q: What if the parcel arrives damaged?
damage.a: You will have a clear way to contact us and request a replacement or return. Exact steps will be described in the terms before launch.

contact.a: Write to the email at the bottom of the page. Phone and company details will be added before the ad campaign so they are accurate and current.

payment.a: You don’t — not yet. This is an early-access signup. Payment methods will be announced when we open orders.

currency.q: Are prices in euro or leva?
currency.a: Prices on the site are in euro (EUR).

fees.a: Not in the advertising and not in how the price is presented. At purchase you will see the product, shipping, and applicable taxes in one place.

difference.a: By silhouette and how you carry them: from a compact city bag to a medium work-and-city shape and a more structured classic. Full dimensions and details will be filled in before launch — for now, choose the one that draws you most.

PRODUCT_01.name: Serena
PRODUCT_01.shortDescription: A roomy trapeze tote with two gold locks — enough for the day, still light in the hand.
PRODUCT_01.summary: Serena is the bag you reach for when the day has layers — laptop sleeve, glasses, a scarf — and you still want clean lines. The trapeze silhouette opens wide; the twin gold locks keep it composed. It reads Italian without shouting: structured enough for the office, soft enough to forget you’re carrying it.

PRODUCT_02.name: Melody
PRODUCT_02.shortDescription: A flat shoulder bag with a curved flap and a quiet gold lock — easy across the body.
PRODUCT_02.summary: Melody sits close to the body and stays out of the way. The curved flap and quiet lock make it feel finished, not flashy — the kind of bag you wear from coffee to dinner without switching. Slim profile, honest leather, one clear gesture.

PRODUCT_03.name: Federica
PRODUCT_03.shortDescription: Soft suede with a drawstring and a leather flap — relaxed, and still finished.
PRODUCT_03.summary: Federica is the soft counterpoint in the collection. Suede that catches light, a leather flap that keeps the line calm, drawstrings that loosen the form just enough. It feels lived-in from day one — for women who want texture over shine, and ease over structure.

PRODUCT_04.name: Conny
PRODUCT_04.shortDescription: A small box bag with a knotted handle — compact, with a clear shape.
PRODUCT_04.summary: Conny is deliberate volume in a small footprint. The box silhouette holds its shape; the knotted handle is the signature — a single handmade gesture. Ideal when you want presence without bulk: evening, short city hops, or as the bag that finishes an outfit.

PRODUCT_05.name: Elisa
PRODUCT_05.shortDescription: A small baguette with a bamboo clasp and a thin strap — for the essentials, nothing more.
PRODUCT_05.summary: Elisa edits the day down to what matters: phone, keys, cardholder. The baguette proportion and bamboo clasp give it a quiet editorial note — warm, tactile, not costume. Wear it high under the arm when you want the look to stay light.

PRODUCT_06.name: Bianca
PRODUCT_06.shortDescription: A structured top-handle with a bamboo clasp and a gold chain — finished, without extra shine.
PRODUCT_06.summary: Bianca is architecture you can hold. Structured body, bamboo clasp, optional gold chain — polish without theatrics. It moves between desk and dinner with the same composure: the bag for women who want one strong silhouette, not a rotation of micro trends.

PRODUCT_07.name: Lila
PRODUCT_07.shortDescription: A compact bucket bag with a round top handle and a gold padlock detail — small, with a clear silhouette.
PRODUCT_07.summary: Lila is compact geometry: a mini bucket with a round handle and a gold padlock as punctuation. Small enough for evenings, defined enough for day. The silhouette is unmistakable from across the room — volume at the base, clean arc above.

PRODUCT_08.name: Fiocco
PRODUCT_08.shortDescription: A soft gathered top-handle with large gold rings and a removable strap — light to carry, day to night.
PRODUCT_08.summary: Fiocco gathers at the top like a soft knot — peplum ease with gold rings that catch the light. Removable strap means hand-held one hour, crossbody the next. It’s the playful piece in the lineup: light, tactile, ready for day into night without a costume change.

PRODUCT_09.name: Sopie
PRODUCT_09.shortDescription: A classic kiss-lock frame clutch with a gold chain — for the essentials, with a vintage note.
PRODUCT_09.summary: Sopie is a wink to vintage frame bags — kiss-lock metal, gold chain, just enough room for the night’s essentials. It doesn’t pretend to be a day tote; it owns the evening. Click the frame shut and the look is complete.

PRODUCT_10.name: Bombola
PRODUCT_10.shortDescription: A mini suede top-handle with a bamboo twist-lock and a gold chain — compact and finished.
PRODUCT_10.summary: Bombola is the smallest finished statement: suede body, bamboo twist-lock, gold chain. Compact enough for a night out, tactile enough to feel special in the hand. A mini with presence — not a shrink-ray of a larger bag.
